title: tab/action
description: Shell-to-engine notification: an edit command on the tab's focused frame (CefFrame::Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, SelectAll), Stop (CefBrowser::StopLoad), or a download of `url` into the download folder (CefBrowserHost::StartDownload; the context menu's Save Image As...). The clipboard is the system's, through Chromium (X11 and Wayland; the headless platform has none). Fire-and-forget, as input is.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).
